full_prompt_en: A square steampunk character portrait shows a masked gunslinger in a tall dark hat holding a long revolver upright against a plain gray-brown studio background. The figure is shown from about the waist upward and turned slightly toward the left, occupying nearly the full height of the frame. The background has a soft smoky gradient, darker near the corners and without any visible setting. A weathered top hat with a wide curved brim sits high on the head, decorated with several small brass clocklike fittings around the band. Beneath it, round dark goggles cover the eyes. The rest of the face is hidden by a dark metallic mask, layered mechanical parts, and stiff bristle-like projections behind the right side of the head. A high collar wraps the neck. The heavy charcoal coat has broad reinforced shoulders, a row of metal clasps, textured leather trim, and deep folds in the sleeves. A pale worn waistcoat and narrow scarf show beneath the open coat, with small brass ornaments at the chest. On the left side of the image, a gloved hand raises an elaborate silver-and-bronze revolver vertically. The long barrel reaches almost to the top edge; small cylinders, screws, and engraved joints catch the light. The other forearm at lower right is enclosed in layered leather and metal bracing. The figure's pose is controlled and still rather than firing or moving. Soft directional light from the upper left grazes the hat brim, goggles, gun, shoulder plating, and creased fabric, while recesses of the mask and coat remain dark. Matte cloth contrasts with worn metallic gleam and scratched leather. There is no readable text. The overall composition is imposing and carefully detailed, using subdued gunmetal color, brass glints, and mechanical surface complexity against a spare backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形蒸汽朋克角色肖像呈现一位蒙面枪手，戴高高的深色帽子，手持一支竖起的长左轮枪，背景是朴素灰棕色影棚空间。人物从约腰部向上入画，身体略朝左转，几乎占满画幅高度。背景带柔和烟状渐层，四角较暗，没有可见场所。一顶磨旧高礼帽高高戴在头上，宽帽檐弯起，帽带周围装着几枚细小黄铜钟表般配件。帽下圆形深色护目镜遮住双眼。脸部其余部分被深色金属面具、层叠机械部件及头部右后侧僵硬的刷毛状凸起藏住。高领围住脖颈。厚重炭黑外套有宽阔加固肩部、一列金属扣、带肌理的皮革镶边和深褶袖子。敞开的外套下露出浅色磨旧马甲和窄围巾，胸前还有细小黄铜饰件。画面左侧，戴手套的手把一把精巧的银铜色左轮枪竖举起来。长枪管几乎伸到上缘；小圆筒、螺丝和雕刻接点接住光。右下另一侧前臂被层叠皮革和金属护具包裹。人物姿态受控而静止，没有开枪或移动。左上方柔和定向光掠过帽檐、护目镜、枪、肩甲和起皱布料，面具与外套凹处仍深暗。哑光布料对照磨旧金属光泽与刮擦皮革。没有可读文字。整体构图威严且细节谨慎，以低调枪灰色、黄铜微光和机械表面复杂度对照空简背景。
style_prompt_en: The retro-industrial character rendering combines worn metal, creased matte fabric, scratched leather, and small brass highlights in a subdued charcoal-brown range. Hard circular fittings and thin articulated lines interrupt broad soft folds, creating a strong contrast of precision and weathering. Directional studio light grazes raised edges and leaves deep seams and recesses dark, so volume emerges from selective metallic gleam rather than an even wash. The central silhouette is upright and imposing, while one narrow vertical accent adds asymmetry. A plain smoky ground isolates the intricate surface and prevents background detail from competing. Materials are described through their distinct responses to light: muted cloth absorbs it, worn leather catches it softly, and metal reflects it in narrow bright streaks. The overall effect is tactile, intricate, and brooding, with controlled value contrast making complex layers readable.
style_prompt_zh: 这种复古工业感角色渲染在低调炭棕色域中结合磨旧金属、起皱哑光布、刮擦皮革和细小黄铜高光。坚硬圆形配件与细长活动线条打断宽阔柔软褶皱，形成精密与风化之间的强对比。定向影棚光掠过凸起边缘，让深接缝和凹处保持黑暗，因此体积从有选择的金属微光中浮现，而非靠均匀晕染。中央剪影挺直而有压迫感，一道狭窄竖向重音增加不对称。朴素烟状背景隔离繁复表面，避免背景细节竞争。材料通过不同受光方式得到描述：低调布料吸收光，磨旧皮革柔和反光，金属以窄而明亮的线状高光回应。整体效果可触、精细而阴郁，有控制的明度反差使复杂层次仍易辨。
theme_en: A masked steampunk gunslinger in a top hat holding a revolver
theme_zh: 一位戴高礼帽、蒙面持左轮枪的蒸汽朋克枪手
name: Steampunk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
